welcome.title: Let's build your learning path
welcome.subtitle: A few quick questions so your quests, streaks, and courses fit you from day one.

language.title: Which language should we use?
language.subtitle: Choose the language for menus, lessons, and everything else in Yuinx.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: This is the name you'll see across your camp and profile.

birthday.title: When were you born?
birthday.subtitle: This helps us keep the experience age-appropriate.

country.title: Where are you learning from?
country.subtitle: Pick your country so we can shape examples around your world.

region.title: Which region or city?
region.subtitle: Optional, but it helps us make your path feel closer to home.

schoolType.title: Where are you learning right now?
schoolType.subtitle: We'll use this to pitch courses at the right level.

school.title: What school do you attend?
school.subtitle: Optional. Add a school, university, or training centre.

grade.title: Which year are you in?
grade.subtitle: Choose the closest match. You can change this later.

degree.title: What are you studying?
degree.subtitle: Tell us your degree level and field of study.

subjects.title: Pick your subjects
subjects.subtitle: Choose up to six. These shape your first quests.

goals.title: What do you want to achieve?
goals.subtitle: Pick up to six goals. We'll keep your path pointed at them.

targetLanguage.title: Which language do you want to learn?
targetLanguage.subtitle: We'll build courses and challenges around this language.

ready.title: One last step
ready.subtitle: Create your account and we'll save your answers to your Yuinx profile.
